edits.proposed: Accidental travel allowances that are not salary. Still reported, still part of the accrued total, but excluded from the contribution base. Not subject to the 40% non-salary clamp of Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30, which applies only to payments agreed as non-salary under a CST art. 128 pact (Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, sentencia de unificación exp. 25185 of 9 December 2021, rule 3); accidental travel allowances are non-salary by law (CST art. 130).

edits.proposed:
Non-salary bonus. Excluded from the contribution base. A bonus agreed as non-salary under an express CST art. 128 pact counts toward the 40% non-salary clamp of Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30 - the excess over 40% of total remuneration is added back into the contribution base; an occasional bonus paid by mere liberality is non-salary by nature and stays outside the clamp (Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, sentencia de unificación exp. 25185 of 9 December 2021, rules 1 and 3).
